head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.title: Core Banking Ledger & Digital Channels Platform
head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.key_risk: Risk R4: Unencrypted internal service links violate PCI-DSS; synchronous ledger lock contention under >2,500 RPS.
head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.key_tradeoff: Tradeoff T4: Strict mTLS & cryptographic audit logging (+Security) vs +12ms P99 serialization latency (-Performance).
head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.non_risk: Non-Risk N4: API Gateway JWT validation with Redis token cache.

head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.title: SEI ATAM Reference Architecture Study #17 (Distributed Control & Microservices)
head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.key_risk: Single point of failure and synchronous blocking calls across tier-3 containers.
head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.key_tradeoff: Redundancy and asynchronous broker replication improve availability (+Availability) at the cost of eventual consistency (-Consistency Overhead).

head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.title: Enterprise Payment Gateway Replacement & Multi-Tenant Audit Logging
head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.key_risk: Interaction Hotspot INT-01 on Order Service when coupling business workflow, payment protocol, and direct DB persistence.
head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.key_tradeoff: Introducing an Event Broker increases initial deployment complexity (-Simplicity) but converts future provider swaps from Indirect to Direct scenarios (+Modifiability).
head4_blackboard_rag_retrieved_studies.non_risk: Direct read-only reporting queries require zero structural modification.

auto_generated_madr_adrs.title: Decouple Synchronous Cascading Chains via Apache Kafka Event Bus
auto_generated_madr_adrs.context: Synchronous REST chains ([['customer', 'web_app', 'order_service'], ['web_app', 'order_service', 'payment_service'], ['web_app', 'order_service', 'order_db']]) create temporal coupling and cascading failure risk under peak load.
auto_generated_madr_adrs.decision: Introduce ContainerQueue(event_bus, 'Apache Kafka') for asynchronous publish/subscribe order & payment events with TLS 1.3.
auto_generated_madr_adrs.consequences: Eliminates blocking thread starvation, reduces P99 latency, and converts SAAM provider changes from Indirect high-effort to low-effort modular updates.

auto_generated_madr_adrs.title: Eliminate Database Single Point of Failure (order_db) via Multi-AZ Read-Replica
auto_generated_madr_adrs.context: Tarjan cut-vertex and stateful inspection identified 'order_db' as a single point of failure threatening availability SLAs.
auto_generated_madr_adrs.decision: Deploy ContainerDb(order_db_replica, 'Multi-AZ Read-Replica') with automated hot standby failover (RTO < 30s) and read offloading.
auto_generated_madr_adrs.consequences: Increases system availability by +0.27% (saving ~21.0 outage hours/year) with minor replication cost.

    title Remediated Architecture — Container Diagram for E-Commerce Ordering System (High-Availability & Decoupled)
    Person(customer, "Customer", "Service", "Places orders via web")
    Container(web_app, "Single Page App", "React", "Storefront UI")
    Container(order_service, "Order Service", "Node.js / Express", "Handles orders")
